hints.title: Row Symmetrical Swap
hints.text: A vertical flip swaps the top rows of the submatrix with the bottom rows.

hints.title: Index Bounds for Halfway Inversion
hints.text: Iterate row offset r from 0 to k // 2 minus 1 and target paired row x + k - 1 - r.

hints.title: Column Swapping
hints.text: Swap elements for each column offset c in the range from 0 to k - 1.

variables: K: Side length of square submatrix
